title: Conservativity of a nonempty constant quotient realization
statement: For a nonempty etale chart, the constant quotient realization functor reflects isomorphism of derived objects over the completion quotient.

source.place: Tags 093J and 03Q3, the nonempty-chart stalk detection part

proof.text: Apply the homology-level lift to the realized isomorphism, obtaining one algebraic morphism whose maps on all cohomology objects are isomorphisms. The unbounded derived isomorphism criterion then gives an isomorphism of the original objects.

proof_origin.place: Tags 093J and 03Q3, the nonempty-chart stalk detection part followed by the unbounded derived isomorphism criterion
